dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Certainly, Mr Lim. We can keep the conversation focused. For future telephone appointments, would you prefer that we arrange a time in advance rather than call unexpectedly?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: An appointment would be better. I can step away from the office properly then. I've got my personal details here as well. From memory, my identity number is F four three four nine seven eight five Q.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Take your time; there is no need to rush through your paperwork.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Sorry, I meant F one three four two seven eight five Q. I was distracted just then. My travel documents and bank papers are all on the desk together.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I'll stay on the line while you find what you need.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: 抱歉，刚才还是说错了。我已经核对证件，正确的证件号码是F一三四九七八五Q，请以这个为准。 我的出生日期是一九五五年十二月三十日。 I've put the travel folder aside now.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you. We can turn to the investment discussion now.
